description: Budget caps and limits for loop sessions (improvement list L52). scripts/loop/preflight.mjs reads this before a session starts any work; hitting a cap stops the loop for that night rather than slowing it. Values set by Tim on 8 November 2026: one session a night and a $20 monthly cap on the judges' API spend; Tim raised the cap to $60 on 10 November 2026 and to $100 on 11 November 2026 (the Console workspace limit). The spend is the judges' recorded cost per run plus estimates for older runs (scripts/loop/spend.mjs); the Judge panel workflow also stops judging once it is reached.

judgeSpendBaseline.note: Judge panel runs in November 2026 before cost artifacts existed, priced from the usage in their review-shadow.json artifacts (124 judged runs).
